paper.title_en: Scalar field perturbations in Non-commutative Schwarzschild spacetime
paper.abstract_en: This work presents a comparative analysis of quasi-normal modes and ringdown profiles of scalar field perturbations in the non-commutative Schwarzschild black hole spacetime, focusing on two non-minimal curvature couplings: in the first, the scalar field is coupled to the Ricci scalar of the background geometry, while in the second, its derivatives are coupled to the Einstein tensor. Using the sixth-order WKB approximation and the time-domain integration method, the dynamical stability is investigated across the parameter space. It is shown that while the tensor model loses its hyperbolic evolution for large couplings, no physical instability is found within its well-posed regime. Moreover, an opposite \(\ell\)-dependence of the threshold couplings is identified between the two models. Finally, using the result of the scalar sector, a model-dependent length scale for the non-commutative parameter is estimated in the case of light primordial black holes.
